description_expanded: Magnolia Manor invites you to experience Grayton Beach in style, with six bedrooms, six and a half bathrooms, and accommodations for up to 16 guests. Just a one-minute bike ride or quick cruise in the 6-seater Low-Speed Vehicle to the sugar-white sands, this remarkable retreat offers partial Gulf views throughout, with a panoramic perspective from the rooftop sundeck. Designed for both relaxation and entertainment, it blends luxury finishes with a welcoming, beachy warmth. Perched on the third floor, the heart of the home is an expansive living area that opens to a screened-in balcony, perfect for enjoying coastal breezes. A chef's kitchen showcases premium appliances, including double Sub-Zero refrigerators, a Wolf oven and range, dual dishwashers, and a butler's pantry with wine and beverage chillers. The adjacent dining area seats twelve, ideal for gathering with family and friends. Downstairs on the first floor, a bonus den and kitchenette offer a second space to relax, with direct access to the private pool deck. The pool features a sun shelf and lounge chairs, while the Grill Hut invites al fresco dining. Each level of Magnolia Manor is thoughtfully arranged for comfort and privacy. The first floor features a king-sized bedroom with access to a shared walk-in shower, a laundry center, and convenient access to the pool. The second floor houses four additional bedrooms, including a luxurious King Primary Suite with a soaking tub, walk-in shower, and private balcony. Two more king bedrooms also enjoy private baths and balconies, while the bunk room features one twin bunk and one queen bunk. The sixth bedroom is on the third floor, complete with a king bed, a walk-in shower, and a private balcony. The neighborhood itself feels like a page from a coastal postcard—shady streets lined with oaks, the scent of salt in the air, and the distant sound of waves rolling onto shore. Grayton Beach favorites like The Red Bar and Chiringo are just minutes away, offering lively music and fresh seafood. Just beyond, you’ll find shops like Lululemon and art galleries showcasing local talent. Grayton Beach State Park, only a four-minute drive, is a must-visit for its rare coastal dune lakes, sugar-sand shoreline, winding trails, and the Turtle Snorkel Reef . With complimentary bikes and the included golf cart, beach access and local attractions are always nearby—and you’ll be back home in time to watch the sunset from your own balcony. Additional comforts include furnished balconies on every level, a fourth-floor sundeck with hanging chairs, laundry centers on the first and second floors, and a driveway parking for four vehicles. Magnolia Manor offers an extraordinary setting for your next Gulf Coast getaway—where every detail is designed to make your stay unforgettable. First Floor: Bonus Den with Pool Deck Access, Kitchenette, King Bedroom with Shared Walk-In Shower, Laundry Second Floor: King Primary Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub + Balcony Access, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access, Bunk Room with One Twin Bunk and One Queen Bunk, Laundry Third Floor: Living Room with Balcony Access, Kitchen, Dining, Powder Room, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access. Fourth Floor: Sundeck *Add $50.00 per day to heat pool (available Oct-April if needed)
